item.title: Solvay stunned by surging electric bills, though its mayor says the village government is not to blame
item.description: Solvay Electric customers have seen sharply higher electric bills this winter due to rising wholesale energy costs and increased transmission costs caused by ice dams affecting a key transmission line.
